# XSESS_PROXY: cross-session day / week / carry-over rules, PROXY (W-XSESS 2026-11-23 07:48Z)

**PROXY, CLOSED-P&L PATH ONLY.** Scored analytically from the landed truly bare (R0) per-session trade lists (net of $4.84 all-in per lot): a rule fires on the closed P&L of the trading day (Globex day, 18:00 ET roll, by entry time) or week and drops every later ENTRY; open P&L between trades and the "close open positions" variants are NOT available here (exact engine rows only). Half-size is a linear x0.5 of the trade P&L (exact only at 2+ lots; inert at 1 lot): scored at 4 lots only. Ranking aid, not a result; nothing queued.

Cells: $/wk / ulcer / max DD / worst week / worst day (daily series over all weekdays of the window, trades dated by entry). Levels in $ per lot-per-book (x lots per book).
